corny.songTitle: You Turn Me On, I’m a Radio
corny.line: I'm a country station, I'm a little bit corny
stanza: Oh honey, you turn me on, I'm a radio
I'm a country station, I'm a little bit corny
I'm a wildwood flower waving for you
I'm a broadcasting tower waving for you

corny.line: And even if it sounds corny
corny.linePrev: Be proud of who you are
corny.lineNext: Don't never let no one tell you

stanza: And she may rise, if I sing you down
And she may wisely cling to the ground
So why would she take me horny?
